description: This file defines a Flutter widget named CategoriesScreen that provides a user interface for managing categories, including adding, renaming, and deleting categories. It uses Provider for state management and interacts with Category models and CategoriesProvider.

classes.name: CategoriesScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays and manages a list of categories, allowing adding, renaming, and deleting categories.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the CategoriesScreen, displaying UI elements for managing categories.

methods.name: _addCategory
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new category using user input.

methods.name: _deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category by its ID.

methods.name: _renameCategoryDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to rename an existing category.
